edits.old: Locate the gully system in the rocky face with two narrow channels 30 feet apart; take the right channel and ascend the narrow then open gully to broken rock to attain the ridge top. Follow the ridge, favoring the west side, to the summit. Most of ridge top has a way trail and the route is partially marked with cairns after leaving the basin, but cairns may be far apart and the way trail may disappear for long stretches. If you lose cairns or way trail most gullies probably work though some may be more difficult than others.
edits.new: In the rocky face you will find a gully system holding two narrow channels 30 feet apart. Choose the right-hand channel and follow the gully, narrow at first and then opening out, up through broken rock to the top of the ridge. Keep to the west side as you follow the ridge to the summit. A way trail runs along most of the ridge top, and cairns mark part of the route once you are out of the basin, though the cairns can be widely spaced and the trail can vanish for long stretches. Should you lose both, most gullies will probably go, although some are harder than others.
